_comment: S1 conversion-parameter sweep.  Same two temperatures as the EUROFER97
character series (C_300_G7 / C_350_G7) but at G=1e-6 rather than the
reactor 1e-7, because at 1e-7 a row reaches only ~2e-5 dpa in 8 minutes
and no dose-ladder rung is populated.  The dose-rate shift is REAL physics
(it changes absolute densities), so these rows are for RANKING conversion
parameter combinations against each other, not for absolute comparison
with the 15 dpa data.  Same G on both temperatures, so the f_100(T) trend
-- the quantity the campaign actually cannot reproduce -- stays a fair test.

S300.label: 300 C, G=1e-6 (accelerated proxy for the 300 C / 15 dpa point)

S350.label: 350 C, G=1e-6 (accelerated proxy for the 350 C / 16.3 dpa point)
